items.prompt: Mobile app icon illustration for a cute cartoon kart battle game: a big close-up of one adorable mint-green battle kart character with an enormous happy grin, huge sparkling cartoon eyes and rosy blushing cheeks, the kart filling most of the frame and facing the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle, thick clean dark outlines, glossy toy-like 3D cartoon render with chunky rounded shapes, vivid candy colors, simple bright sunshine-yellow radial gradient background with a few tiny confetti sparkles, bold and instantly readable at small icon sizes, centered composition, no text, no watermark, no logos.
